thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning to run a TTL cleanup + retention backfill on user_events during tomorrow's change window (03:00-04:00 UTC). It's a streaming job that touches ~8M rows across 4 shards. Needs a short quiesce for safe index updates.

 todd: +1. What's the exact holdpoint and version pin? we should pin the services to v2.4.1 for the cutover.

 deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria for 3177778342 at 2026-03-22T03:15:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 3177778342`. To abort running job: `/deploy abort <job-id>`.

 samir: Suggest canary on shard-2 for 10min, then proceed staggered. Also enable feature flag `ttl_backfill_safe=true` for the duration.

 maria: Plan: canary shard-2 -> observe locks and replica lag. Abort criteria: any lock > 5s OR replica lag > 5s OR error rate spike on write path. Rollback plan: `/deploy rollback 3177778342` + restore read-only safepoint snapshot.

 kate: On-call confirmed. I'll watch locks, replica lag and perf dashboards. Dash: https://console.redwood/d/replication?org=user_events

 oncall-ops: Quick ask — can someone paste the SQL we should use to alert on long row-level locks? I'll add a temporary alert rule.

 samir: Use this for locks: ```SELECT pid, state, wait_event_type, wait_event, query FROM pg_stat_activity a JOIN pg_locks l ON a.pid = l.pid WHERE l.mode LIKE '%Exclusive%' AND a.state <> 'idle';``` Also preflight row count: ```SELECT count(*) FROM user_events WHERE last_seen < now() - interval '90 days';```

 todd: Preflight checks also: feature flag and service version: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/v1/featureflags/ttl_backfill_safe``` and ```psql -c "SELECT current_setting('app.version');"```

 deploy-bot: canary run started on shard-2 (job id jb_9901). Logs: https://deploy/logs/jb_9901. Watch job status with `/deploy status jb_9901`.

 maria: Observing logs — some tombstone churn but write latency within SLO so far. Kate please confirm replica lag + lock counts.

 kate: Replica lag 0.8s, locks transient <2s. No abnormal errors seen. Proceeding with staggered rollout to shard-1 at 03:30 UTC.

 samir: Emergency stop instructions if needed: `/deploy abort jb_9901` then on DB: ```SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%backfill%' AND state <> 'idle';```

 maria: I'll update release notes with rollback steps, contact list, and validation queries. Final go/no-go ping at 03:10 UTC.

 todd: Got it, thanks :thumbsup:

 deploy-bot: job jb_9901 completed: status SUCCESS. duration 12m. Summary: ~2M rows processed on shard-2; no errors.

 kate: Post-run checks passed: replication healthy, no lingering locks. Moving to remaining shards in staggered waves.

 maria: Closing thread — will open a short runbook entry and a follow-up postmortem if any regression appears. Thanks everyone :rocket:
